title_en: Networks, HTTP, APIs, identity and security
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: CH-15..CH-20 zigzag and CH-17 before CH-23 (ADR-001): open and close with callbacks that re-establish where we are on the A-01 map and name the chapter we return to.

sentences.ar: أي نداء لأي service بيبدأ باسم مش عنوان.
sentences.en: Every service call starts as a name that is not an address.

sentences.ar: الـDNS بيحلّه، وبعدها رسالتك بتتقطّع packets، كل واحدة بتتوجّه لوحدها وعشان كده الشبكة ممكن تضيّع واحدة وما تضيّعش الباقي.
sentences.en: DNS resolves it, and then your message is cut into packets, each routed independently — which is why a network can lose one and not the others.

sentences.ar: الـTCP بيبني الاعتمادية فوق عدم الاعتمادية دي بـsequence numbers وacknowledgements، والـTLS بيضيف مصافحة تانية للهوية والتشفير.
sentences.en: TCP builds reliability on top of that unreliability with sequence numbers and acknowledgements, and TLS adds a second handshake for identity and encryption.

sentences.ar: وعشان كده الـconnection البارد أبطأ بتلاتة ونص مرات من الدافي، وعشان كده إعادة استخدام الاتصال من أعلى الحاجات قيمة اللي الـclient يقدر يعملها.
sentences.en: That is why a cold connection is three and a half times slower than a warm one, and why connection reuse is one of the highest-value things a client can do.

sentences.ar: بعدها HTTP. method وpath وheaders وbody وstatus code والـstatus codes مش معلومات للحفظ.
sentences.en: Then HTTP. A method, a path, headers, a body, and a status code — and status codes are not trivia.
Four-oh-one says I do not know who you are.

sentences.ar: 403 بتقول أنا عارفك كويس وبرضه مش هتعرف.
sentences.en: Four-oh-three says I know exactly who you are and you still may not.
Five hundred says the fault is mine, not yours.

sentences.ar: الأربع جمل دول بيقولولك مين اللي لازم يصلّح المشكلة، ودي كل الحكاية من تعلّمهم.
sentences.en: Those four sentences tell you who has to fix the problem, which is the entire point of learning them.

sentences.ar: والـAPI contract هو الوعد اللي حوالين ده كله: inputs متحقَّق منها، وأشكال أخطاء صريحة، وpagination، وidempotency، وversioning مكتوبين في specification مش عايشين في دماغ مطور واحد.
sentences.en: An API contract is the promise around all of that: validated inputs, explicit error shapes, pagination, idempotency, versioning — written down in a specification rather than living in one developer's head.

sentences.ar: بعدها الهوية. الـauthentication بتسأل إنت مين؛ والـauthorization بتسأل مسموح لك تعمل إيه ودي أشهر ثغرة خطيرة في الأنظمة الحقيقية.
sentences.en: Then identity. Authentication asks who you are; authorisation asks what you may do — and this is the single most common serious vulnerability in real systems.

sentences.ar: بصّ: أنا غيّرت الرقم في الـURL وقريت order مش بتاعي.
sentences.en: Watch: I change the identifier in the URL and read an order that is not mine.
The token was valid the whole time.

sentences.ar: الفحص الناقص ما كانش إنت داخل؟ كان دي بتاعتك؟
sentences.en: The check that was missing was not are you logged in, it was is this yours.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

first_mention_gloss.gloss_ar: إن تكرار نفس الطلب ما يعملش أثر زيادة

glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: Domain Name System: the internet's directory that translates a site name into the IP address needed to connect.
concepts.def_ar: دليل الإنترنت اللي بيحوّل اسم الموقع لعنوان الـIP اللي محتاجينه عشان نتصل.
concepts.failure: Forgetting DNS is a lookup step that can fail or return stale answers.

concepts.def_en: Transport Layer Security: a handshake that proves the server's identity and encrypts data in transit between client and server.
concepts.def_ar: بروتوكول بيعمل handshake يثبت هوية السيرفر ويشفّر الداتا أثناء انتقالها بين العميل والسيرفر.
concepts.failure: Skipping certificate verification, which leaves traffic encrypted but possibly sent to an impostor.

concepts.def_en: HyperText Transfer Protocol: the request-response protocol of the web, built from methods…
concepts.failure: Treating status codes as trivia, returning 200 for errors so clients cannot react correct…

concepts.def_en: Environment variable listing the folders the shell searches, in order, to find the progra…
concepts.failure: Getting 'command not found' because the program's folder isn't listed in PATH.

concepts.def_en: Splitting a large result into pages returned a chunk at a time, using limit and offset or cursors, so responses stay small and fast.
concepts.def_ar: تقسيم النتايج الكبيرة صفحات بترجع حتة حتة باستخدام limit وoffset أو cursors، عشان الردود تفضل صغيرة وسريعة.
concepts.failure: Returning the whole table at once, or paging without a stable sort order.

concepts.def_en: Running an operation or request again gives the same result as running it once, so a stop…
concepts.failure: Rerunning a plain INSERT load after failure and silently duplicating the data.

concepts.def_en: Application Programming Interface: a defined contract through which one program requests…
concepts.failure: Changing a response field or meaning without versioning, breaking every client that depen…

concepts.def_en: Verifying who a user or system is, for example with a password or a valid token.
concepts.def_ar: الـauthentication إنك تتأكد إنت مين فعلًا، يوزر أو سيستم، بباسورد أو token صالح.
concepts.failure: Confusing it with authorization: knowing who someone is does not say what they may do.

concepts.def_en: Deciding what an already identified user is allowed to do, such as which data or actions they may access.
concepts.def_ar: الـauthorization هو تحديد اللي مسموح لليوزر المعروف يعمله، زي أنهي داتا أو أكشن يقدر يوصللها.
concepts.failure: Checking permissions only in the UI, not on the server for every request.

concepts.def_en: A piece of text, often a word fragment, that a language model reads as one unit; rare words cost several tokens.
concepts.def_ar: قطعة نص، غالباً جزء من كلمة، بيقراها الـlanguage model كوحدة واحدة؛ والكلمة النادرة بتاخد أكتر من token.
concepts.failure: Assuming one token equals one word; rare words split into several pieces.

Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A request travelling hops (client, lb, service, cache, db, queue, external) with per-hop latency.
A status stamp on a target.
Doors by clearance level; a keycard opens some.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
